cms_public_notices.observation: Canonical CMS public notices listing shows no October 31 notices. Its seven October 30 termination notices, CCNs B31564, A11721, 234047, 368355, 368395, 369294 and 369309, were present in earlier watch runs and are excluded as duplicates. Regulatory termination notice is not proof of a facility's physical closure.
